questions: Should the shuffle order be the same across all columns of a given DataFrame, but independent across different DataFrames, or should the same shuffle order be used for all DataFrames?
If a sublist contains duplicate column names, should the DataFrame have duplicate columns, or should duplicates be handled (e.g., ignored or raise an error)?
Is the length of each DataFrame's rows always exactly the length of POSSIBLE_VALUES, even if POSSIBLE_VALUES is empty?
Should the function preserve the order of columns in each DataFrame as they appear in the sublist, or is any order acceptable as long as columns are present?
If POSSIBLE_VALUES contains duplicates, should the shuffle operate on the list as given (including duplicates) or on unique values?
Is the shuffle required to be in-place using random.shuffle, or are other randomization methods (e.g., numpy.random.permutation) acceptable as long as the effect is the same?
Should the function reset or seed the random number generator to ensure reproducibility, or is any random shuffle acceptable?
If a sublist is empty, does the resulting DataFrame have zero rows (since no columns) or zero rows and zero columns?
